details: Each coordinate projection can be learned by querying only its effective coordinates.
proof: For every coordinate projection $\mathcal{G}$ of $\mathcal{H}$, querying all coordinates in the effective range of $\mathcal{G}$ distinguishes every pair of its concepts.  Thus $\mathrm{Q}_m(\mathcal{G})\le\mathrm{E}(\mathcal{G})\le\mathrm{E}(\mathcal{H})$.  Maximizing over projections gives $\mathrm{Q}_m^p(\mathcal{H})\le\mathrm{E}(\mathcal{H})$.
name: Effective Range / Projected Membership Queries Complexity
